approval_ref: The active user goal assigns task, result, citation and review management to CIRP and requires a lightweight verifiable boundary around the advanced-model reference analyst.
notes: Persist only a bounded safe failure code and generic detail for local preflight or safely settled model-contract rejection; never persist rejected provider text or an unvalidated answer.
A terminal failed item is idempotent and is not retried automatically. Sequential execution may continue to later pending items only after unresolved-call state is confirmed empty.
Unresolved calls, frozen-profile mismatch, provider transport or policy errors and unclassified failures continue to stop the sequence.
Reject only literal compact Building/Bldg identity conflicts. Do not infer entities from sheet numbers, file names or a semantic graph.
The prior fixed-15 live score is historical and must not be retroactively changed without a new controlled run.

Full offline validation passed: 1,499 Python tests, 24 localization tests, 11 deployment tests, 147 synchronized requirements, 21 schemas and a 612-file bundle manifest before the final task-status refresh.
title: Persist safe evaluation failures and guard explicit question entities
objective: Make frozen Reference evaluations finish cleanly across safe contract failures without automatic retry, and fail closed when a model substitutes an explicit building identity named by the question.
